title: signup CTA on /compare pages 404s — visit cannot become signup
body:
funnel_stage: signup
source: direction#4518

metric: signup clicks on /compare/* reach the signup form

observed: 2026-09-22 the CTA href points at /signup which 404s

evidence:
- https://0509.io/compare/pulzifi
- curl -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://0509.io/signup -> 404

accept:
- /signup resolves or the CTA points at the real signup route

verify:
curl -s https://0509.io/compare/pulzifi | grep -o 'href="[^"]*"' | grep -i signup

rollback: revert the CTA href

dedupe: none

impact: every /compare visit dead-ends before signup

product_surface: /compare/* CTA

termination: curl -fsS -o /dev/null https://0509.io/signup

note: earlier draft mentioned a migrations/** backfill for click tracking — descoped, see comments
